rows.section: Maryland corporate income and franchise taxes
rows.label: Corporate income tax rate
rows.note: Flat rate on Maryland taxable income (from the 2025 corporate instructions); no enacted change for 2026 was found.
rows.source_title: Comptroller of Maryland: 2025 Maryland Corporation Income Tax Return Instructions (PDF)

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: Counties and Baltimore City (plus municipalities), with a small State property tax on top
rows.note: Each county and Baltimore City sets its own rate every year before June 20.
rows.source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 6-302 (Maryland General Assembly)

rows.label: State property tax
rows.value: Yes: rate set each year by the Board of Public Works
rows.note: Maryland levies a State property tax in addition to county and city taxes.
rows.source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 6-301 (Maryland General Assembly)

rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT)
rows.note: SDAT's director administers the Tax-Property Article. SDAT's own website (dat.maryland.gov) refused automated access, so the statute is cited.
rows.source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 2-201 (Maryland General Assembly)

rows.label: Homestead assessment-increase cap
rows.value: 10% a year for the State tax; counties and cities set 0% to 10%
rows.note: Homestead tax credit: taxable assessment of an owner-occupied home is limited to 110% of the prior year for State tax; local percentage 100% to 110%.
rows.source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 9-105 (Maryland General Assembly)

rows.label: State transfer tax rate
rows.note: 0.5% of the consideration, including any mortgage assumed by the buyer.
rows.source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 13-203 (Maryland General Assembly)

rows.label: State transfer tax rate for first-time Maryland home buyers
rows.note: 0.25% on improved residential property bought as a principal residence by first-time Maryland buyers; paid entirely by the seller.
rows.source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 13-203 (Maryland General Assembly)

rows.label: Local recordation and transfer taxes
rows.value: Counties levy their own recordation taxes and property transfer taxes, collected by the Clerk of the Circuit Court
rows.note: Rates vary by county and are added to the State transfer tax.
rows.source_title: Comptroller of Maryland: Business and personal tax tip #30, A Brief Look at Maryland Taxes (PDF)
